aspects.description: Application runs against the provided swaploop_admin MySQL seed
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Import assets/db/swaploop_admin.sql into MySQL database swaploop_admin and start the app. Seeded staff accounts (e.g. admin@swaploop.test / password123) can be used for sign-in.

aspects.description: Server-side project structure and maintainability
judgementScoreDescription: Code is unstructured; unclear separation of routes, views, and data access
Basic folder structure exists but naming and layering are inconsistent
Clear SSR project layout with sensible separation of routes/controllers, views, and data access
Excellent modular structure, consistent patterns, and easy-to-follow server-rendered architecture

aspects.description: Staff can sign in with email and password against staff_users
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as admin@swaploop.test with password123. Authentication succeeds against staff_users and a signed-in session is established.

aspects.description: Invalid credentials show a clear error message
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit a wrong password for a known email. A clear error is shown and no session is created.

aspects.description: Suspended accounts cannot sign in
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as suspended.admin@swaploop.test with password123. Sign-in fails and no authenticated session is created.

aspects.description: Suspended sign-in shows a distinct suspended message
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Attempt suspended.admin@swaploop.test / password123. The message is distinct from a generic invalid-credentials error.

aspects.description: Authentication uses a server-side session
aspects.extraDescription: Test: After login, subsequent requests stay authenticated via cookie/session. Clearing the session cookie forces re-login.

aspects.description: Signed-in users can sign out
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in, then sign out. The session ends and protected pages require login again.

aspects.description: Unauthenticated visitors only reach the login experience
aspects.extraDescription: Test: While signed out, open dashboard and staff/station URLs directly. Each redirects to or only shows login.

aspects.description: Shell shows product name SwapLoop Admin
aspects.extraDescription: Test: After login, signed-in chrome shows product name SwapLoop Admin.

aspects.description: Shell shows the current user name and role
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Sign in as admin@swaploop.test and accountant@swaploop.test. Header shows that user's name and role.

aspects.description: Navigation is limited to what the signed-in role may use
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare nav for PLATFORM_ADMIN, FLEET_MANAGER, STATION_ADMIN, and ACCOUNTANT. Each role only sees links for areas it may use.

aspects.description: Shell includes a sign-out control
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Signed-in shell provides a visible sign-out control.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN dashboard summarises network-relevant counts
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As admin@swaploop.test, dashboard shows network-wide summary counts relevant to platform admin.

aspects.description: FLEET_MANAGER dashboard summarises own partner scope
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As fleet.swift@swaploop.test, dashboard summarises that partner's scope, not other partners' data.

aspects.description: STATION_ADMIN dashboard summarises assigned stations and units
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As station.east@swaploop.test, dashboard reflects assigned station(s)/units only.

aspects.description: ACCOUNTANT dashboard provides a finance entry point
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As accountant@swaploop.test, landing clearly leads to the finance report.

aspects.description: Login page layout matches the login wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare login page to assets/wireframes/login.svg — email, password, and submit controls are present in a matching layout.

aspects.description: Dashboard layout matches the dashboard wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As PLATFORM_ADMIN, compare dashboard to assets/wireframes/dashboard.svg.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can access staff, stations, units, partners, drivers, billing, and finance
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As admin@swaploop.test, each listed area is reachable and usable.

aspects.description: FLEET_MANAGER can only access own partner drivers and own partner billing
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As fleet.swift@swaploop.test, SwiftRice drivers/billing work; staff, stations CRUD, other partners, and foreign billing do not.

aspects.description: STATION_ADMIN is limited to assigned stations and their units
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As station.east@swaploop.test, only assigned station(s) and their units are manageable.

aspects.description: STATION_ADMIN cannot create new stations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As station.east@swaploop.test, create-station is unavailable or the mutation is rejected.

aspects.description: ACCOUNTANT can only use finance report and CSV (read-only)
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As accountant@swaploop.test, finance works; staff/station/partner/driver mutation screens are inaccessible.

aspects.description: Cross-scope requests show the access-denied experience
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Open an out-of-scope resource URL as a scoped user. The access-denied page/wireframe is shown.

aspects.description: Cross-scope lists do not expose foreign data
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As fleet.blue@swaploop.test, driver list is BlueCrane-only. As station.canal@swaploop.test, unassigned stations/units are omitted.

aspects.description: Access-denied page matches the access-denied wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Trigger access denied and compare to assets/wireframes/access-denied.svg.

aspects.description: Server-side enforcement blocks out-of-scope mutations even without UI controls
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit a crafted POST/PUT for an out-of-scope entity while signed in as a scoped role. Server rejects it; foreign data is unchanged.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN staff list page is implemented
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As admin@swaploop.test, open staff list and see seeded staff rows.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can create a staff account with password
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create a staff user with email, password, role, and role-specific fields. User appears in the list and can sign in.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can edit an existing staff account
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Edit a staff user's name or status and save. Changes persist on reload.

aspects.description: Staff role is exactly one of the four defined roles
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create/edit only allows PLATFORM_ADMIN, FLEET_MANAGER, STATION_ADMIN, ACCOUNTANT — one role per user.

aspects.description: Fleet managers require a partner; other roles must not carry a partner
aspects.extraDescription: Test: FLEET_MANAGER without partner fails. Non–fleet-manager roles with a partner fail or partner is cleared.

aspects.description: Station admins require at least one station assignment; other roles must not
aspects.extraDescription: Test: STATION_ADMIN with zero stations fails. Non–station-admin roles with station assignments fail or are rejected.

aspects.description: Staff status supports active and suspended
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Toggle a staff user between active and suspended; list/detail reflect the status.

aspects.description: Platform admin cannot suspend their own account
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As admin@swaploop.test, attempt to suspend that same account. Action is blocked.

aspects.description: Leaving password blank on edit keeps the existing hash
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Edit a user, leave password blank, save. Previous password still works.

aspects.description: Staff create/edit form fields match the staff-form wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare staff form to assets/wireframes/staff-form.svg for role, partner, station assignment, status, and password fields.

aspects.description: Stations list page is implemented for in-scope users
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As PLATFORM_ADMIN, stations list shows seeded stations. As STATION_ADMIN, only assigned stations appear.

aspects.description: Only PLATFORM_ADMIN can create stations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As admin@swaploop.test create a station successfully. As station.east@swaploop.test, create is unavailable or rejected.

aspects.description: Station can be edited within allowed lifecycle rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Edit an ACTIVE station's address/name and save. Changes persist.

aspects.description: Station type is SWAP, CHARGING, or HYBRID
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Form only accepts those three types; saved value persists.

aspects.description: New stations may start only as PLANNED or ACTIVE
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Creating as SUSPENDED or DECOMMISSIONED is rejected; PLANNED and ACTIVE succeed.

aspects.description: Allowed lifecycle transitions are enforced
aspects.extraDescription: Test: PLANNED→ACTIVE/DECOMMISSIONED; ACTIVE→SUSPENDED/DECOMMISSIONED; SUSPENDED→ACTIVE/DECOMMISSIONED. Disallowed transitions are rejected.

aspects.description: DECOMMISSIONED stations accept no further changes
aspects.extraDescription: Test: After DECOMMISSIONED, further edits/status changes fail.

aspects.description: Suspended stations require a reason; non-suspended must not keep one
aspects.extraDescription: Test: SUSPENDED without reason fails. With reason succeeds. Returning to ACTIVE clears/forbids keeping a suspension reason.

aspects.description: Station form fields match the station-form wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare station form to assets/wireframes/station-form.svg (type, lifecycle, suspension reason, address fields).

aspects.description: Units list page is implemented for in-scope stations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As PLATFORM_ADMIN or assigned STATION_ADMIN, open units list for an in-scope station and see existing units.

aspects.description: In-scope users can create and edit units under their stations
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create and edit a unit on an in-scope station. Changes persist. Out-of-scope stations reject unit mutations.

aspects.description: Unit status is AVAILABLE or BLOCKED; blocked requires a reason
aspects.extraDescription: Test: BLOCKED without reason fails. With reason succeeds. AVAILABLE does not keep a block reason.

aspects.description: SWAP_BAY requires battery type and must not have connector type
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create SWAP_BAY with battery_type SL-48 or SL-60 and no connector. Wrong combination is rejected.

aspects.description: BIKE_BAY requires connector type and must not have battery type
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create BIKE_BAY with connector_type GB-AC-48 or GB-AC-60 and no battery type. Wrong combination is rejected.

aspects.description: Unit labels are unique within a station
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Two units on the same station with the same label — second create/update is rejected.

aspects.description: Station type constrains allowed unit kinds
aspects.extraDescription: Test: SWAP stations only SWAP_BAY; CHARGING only BIKE_BAY; HYBRID both. Wrong kind is rejected.

aspects.description: Unit form fields match the unit-form wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare unit form to assets/wireframes/unit-form.svg (kind, status, battery/connector, block reason).

aspects.description: Partners and drivers list pages are implemented
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As PLATFORM_ADMIN, open partner-list and driver-list screens and see seeded rows.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN can create and edit delivery partners
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Create/edit a partner with name, status, contact, fleet size, and subscription plan. Changes persist.

aspects.description: Partner is assigned a subscription plan from the database
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Partner form lists plans from subscription_plans. Saving assigns plan_id from the database.

aspects.description: PLATFORM_ADMIN manages all drivers; FLEET_MANAGER only own partner drivers
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Admin manages drivers across partners. fleet.swift@swaploop.test only manages SwiftRice drivers.

aspects.description: Driver employee code is unique per partner
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Same employee code twice on one partner is rejected.

aspects.description: Driver email is unique
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Creating a driver with an already-used email fails.

aspects.description: Driver status supports active and suspended
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Set a driver to suspended and back to active; list reflects status.

aspects.description: Partner and driver forms match their wireframes
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare partner-form.svg and driver-form.svg to implemented forms.

aspects.description: Billing summary opens for a partner and selected calendar month with correct scope
aspects.extraDescription: Test: PLATFORM_ADMIN can open any partner's billing. FLEET_MANAGER only their own. Month selector uses calendar months.

aspects.description: Monthly completed uses are aggregated from usage_events in Asia/Shanghai
aspects.extraDescription: Test: For a seeded partner/month (July or August 2026), displayed use count matches events whose completed_at falls in that Asia/Shanghai calendar month.

aspects.description: Billing applies plan monthly base fee, included quota, and overage rate from the database
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Breakdown matches the partner's subscription_plans row (e.g. plan-001: 5000 / 400 / 5). Overage uses = max(0, uses − quota).

aspects.description: Volume discount tier matches monthly usage and reduces overage only
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Pick a partner/month in a known discount_tiers band. Discount percent matches that tier and applies only to overage; base fee stays undiscounted.

aspects.description: Billing breakdown shows partner, period, plan, uses, quota, overage, fees, discount, and total
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Billing summary includes each field as in assets/wireframes/billing-summary.svg.

aspects.description: Billing amounts are whole CNY yuan
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Displayed monetary amounts are whole yuan (no fractional fen).

aspects.description: Commercial numbers come from the database seed, not hard-coded application constants
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Billing figures match seed plan/tier values; commercial numbers are read from the database rather than hard-coded as the only source of truth.

subCriterions.name: Finance report, chart, and CSV export

aspects.description: Accountants and platform admins can open the network finance view for a selected month
aspects.extraDescription: Test: As accountant@swaploop.test and admin@swaploop.test, open finance for a month. Fleet/station roles cannot.

aspects.description: Finance table has one row per partner plus a network total
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Table lists each partner for the month and a network total row, matching finance-report wireframe structure.

aspects.description: Finance row calculations match the partner billing summary rules
aspects.extraDescription: Test: For the same partner and month, finance figures match the partner billing summary.

aspects.description: Vertical bar chart shows each partner total without an external chart library
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Finance page renders a vertical bar chart via SVG/canvas/custom drawing — not a third-party chart library.

aspects.description: Chart covers every partner total for the selected month
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Each partner finance row has a corresponding bar for that partner's total.

aspects.description: CSV export downloads per-partner rows as UTF-8 with a header row
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Export CSV for a month. File is UTF-8, has a header row, and one data row per partner.

aspects.description: CSV column order is deterministic
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Export twice for the same month; column order is identical.

aspects.description: CSV filename identifies the billing period
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Filename includes the selected year-month (or equivalent period identifier).

aspects.description: Finance report layout matches the finance-report wireframe
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Compare table, chart, month selector, and CSV control placement to assets/wireframes/finance-report.svg.

subCriterions.name: List pages: filters, pagination, and empty states

aspects.description: Staff, stations, units, partners, and drivers lists support basic filtering
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On each index, apply at least one relevant filter (search/name, status, type/role, partner or station where applicable). Results narrow correctly.

aspects.description: Index lists paginate with page size 10
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On a list with more than 10 in-scope rows, page size is 10 and page navigation works.

aspects.description: Pagination controls are available when a list spans multiple pages
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On a multi-page list, next/previous or page controls advance through pages.

aspects.description: Distinct empty state when there are no records in scope
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Empty scope shows copy indicating no records in scope — not a filter miss.

aspects.description: Distinct empty state when filters match nothing
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Filters matching zero rows while records exist in scope show a no-matches empty state.

aspects.description: List queries respect role scope so out-of-scope rows never appear
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Fleet and station admin lists never show foreign partner/station rows even when searching broadly.

aspects.description: Invalid form submissions show field-level errors from server-side validation
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Submit CRUD forms with missing required fields. Per-field errors appear after server validation; invalid data is not saved.

aspects.description: Status and errors are understandable without relying on colour alone
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Error and status cues include text/icons/labels, not colour-only indicators.

aspects.description: List and detail status values include text labels, not colour alone
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On staff/station/unit/driver lists, statuses are readable as text (or text+icon), not only by colour.

aspects.description: Form controls have associated labels
aspects.extraDescription: Test: On login and at least two CRUD forms, inputs have visible/programmatic labels.

aspects.description: Keyboard focus order follows the wireframe field order
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Tab through login and one create form; focus order matches wireframe field order.

aspects.description: Overall visual design quality of the admin console
judgementScoreDescription: Layout is incomplete or visually inconsistent; hard to use
Basic readable layout with limited visual polish
Clear, consistent admin UI with good spacing, typography, and hierarchy
Polished, professional admin design that strongly supports efficient staff workflows

aspects.description: Screen layouts match the provided wireframes
judgementScoreDescription: Screens diverge substantially from wireframes; key regions missing
Main regions present but field placement often differs
Layouts closely follow wireframe structure and field placement on most screens
Excellent fidelity to wireframes across shell, lists, forms, billing, and finance screens

aspects.description: Usability of primary admin workflows
judgementScoreDescription: Workflows are confusing; frequent dead-ends or unclear next steps
Main CRUD paths work but navigation and feedback are uneven
Clear paths for list → create/edit → save with understandable feedback
Excellent usability: efficient navigation, clear actions, and confident completion of admin tasks

aspects.description: Signed-in chrome (header/nav) is consistent across authenticated pages
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Navigate between dashboard, a list, a form, and finance as admin. Shell regions remain consistent.

aspects.description: List and form screens expose the fields indicated by the wireframes
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Spot-check staff, station, billing-summary, and finance-report screens against assets/wireframes for required fields/controls.

aspects.description: Finance and billing screens present amounts and breakdowns clearly
aspects.extraDescription: Test: Billing summary and finance table present numeric breakdowns in a scannable labeled layout.
